globalAnalysis.visualFlow: Thick curved brushstrokes sweep through stormy sky, red-orange fields, green shrubs, a low village, and a tall red tree.
globalAnalysis.curatorialNote: Nature dominates, but repeated horizon buildings and the bare red tree add geometric accents; density and saturation should drive the fastest score of the set.

cells.label: Sky vortex
